puebla: poblar — he fills, peoples, occupies (present 3rd sg.; bien puebla el otero 'he occupies the hill well'; = puebla)
firme: firme — firm; used adverbially, 'firmly, securely' (= firmemente)
prende: prender — he takes, takes up (present 3rd sg.; prende las posadas 'takes up quarters'; = prende)
contra: contra — toward, facing, in the direction of (= hacia; contra la sierra 'facing the sierra')
cinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg., Latin cinxit; en buen ora cinxo espada 'in a good hour he girded on the sword'; = ciñó)
fazer: fazer — to make, do, dig (infinitive; mandó fazer 'ordered made'; = hacer)
arrebata: arrebata — sudden attack, surprise assault (noun from arrebatar; dar arrebata 'to make a sudden attack'; probably = arrebato/arrebatada)
sopiessen: saber — (so that) they might know (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; = supiesen/supieran)
fincança: fincança — staying, sojourn, settled stay (noun from fincar 'to stay'; avie fincança 'had settled in'; = permanencia, estancia)
mandados: mandado — message, news, report (pl.; here the tidings that spread; = mandados)
venido: venir — come (past part.; venido es 'has come', ser as perfect auxiliary; = venido)
alegrando: alegrar — rejoicing, cheering (gerund; alegrando se va 'goes along rejoicing'; = alegrándose)
paria: paria — tribute paid by a Muslim town for protection (sg.; en paria 'as tribute'; see parias)
yal: ya + le — now ... to him (ya 'now' + elided le; yal dan parias 'now they pay him tribute')
terrer: Terrer — place name, a town near Calatayud (probably modern Terrer, Zaragoza province)
calatauth: Calatauth — place name, Calatayud (Zaragoza province; from Arabic Qal'at Ayyūb)
sabet: saber — know, mark you (imperative 2nd pl., sabed; sabet = sabed; epic tag addressed to the audience)
ma: mal — ill, sorely (adverb, with the l lost before les: ma'les = mal les, Pidal; ma'les pesava 'it grieved them sorely'; = mal)
pesava: pesar — it grieved, it weighed on (imperfect 3rd sg.; les pesava 'it grieved them'; = pesaba)
yogo: yazer — he lay, stayed encamped (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = yació)
complidas: complido — complete, full (fem. pl.; complidas quinze sedmanas 'a full fifteen weeks'; = cumplidas)
elle: elle — he (old form of él, Latin ille; elle fizo = él hizo; Pidal restores el[le])
art: art — trick, stratagem of war (masc. here, un art; Latin ars; Pidal 'ardid de guerra'; = arte, ardid)
levava: levar — he was carrying off, taking away (imperfect 3rd sg.; = llevaba)
alçada: alçar — raised (past part. fem.; la su seña alçada 'with his banner raised'; = alzada)
lorigas: loriga — coat of mail, hauberk (pl.; = lorigas)
vestidas: vestir — put on, clad in (past part. fem. pl.; = vestidas)
çintas: çinto — girded, belted on (old strong past part. of çeñir, Latin cinctus, used as adjective, fem. pl.; çintas las espadas 'with swords girded on'; = ceñidas)
sacarlos: sacar + los — to draw them out (infinitive with enclitic object; sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'; = sacarlos)
vidienlo: veer + lo — they saw him (imperfect 3rd pl. vidien, an old form, with enclitic lo; = lo veían)
alabavan: alabar — they were boasting, praising themselves (imperfect 3rd pl., reflexive alabarse; = alababan)
fallido: fallir — failed, lacking, run out (past part.; fallido ha a mio Çid el pan 'the Cid has run out of bread'; = faltado)
abés: abés — hardly, scarcely (Latin ad vix; = apenas)
lieva: levar — he carries off (present 3rd sg.; = lleva)
dexada: dexar — left (past part.; una tienda a dexada 'he has left one tent'; = dejada)
escapasse: escapar — (as if) he were escaping (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing'; = escapase)
arrancada: arrancada — rout, headlong flight; also the pursuit and rout of the enemy (de arrancada 'in rout'; el arrancada, el before a vowel-initial fem. noun; = arrancada)
demos: dar — let us give (present subjunctive 1st pl.; demos salto 'let us make a dash'; = demos)
prenden: prender — they take, seize (present 3rd pl.; = prenden)
darán: dar — they will give (future 3rd pl.; = darán)
dent: dent — of it, thereof (de + ent, a form of ende 'thence'; non nos darán dent nada 'they will give us none of it'; = de ello)
qu: que — that, which (que elided before a vowel; qu'él a presa 'that he has taken')
presa: prender — taken (past part. fem.; la paria que a presa 'the tribute he has taken'; = prendida, tomada)
much: mucho — much, very (apocopated form; much estraña 'very strange/great')
estraña: estraño — extraordinary, remarkable, great (fem.; priessa much estraña 'a most extraordinary rush'; = extraña)
cogiós: coger + se — he withdrew, took himself off (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic se, cogióse; cogiós commo de arrancada 'he withdrew as if in rout'; = se recogió)
cojós: coger + se — he went off, took himself (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic se, cojóse; cojós Salón ayuso 'he set off down the Jalón'; = se fue)
anda: andar — he goes, goes along (present 3rd sg.; = anda)
chicos: chico — small, little (masc. pl.; los grandes e los chicos 'great and small'; = chicos)
guarda: guardar — he guards, watches (present 3rd sg.; = guarda)
entrellos: entre + ellos — between them (entrellos y el castiello 'between them and the castle'; = entre ellos)
plaça: plaça — open space, stretch of open ground (here distance; = plaza)
espoloneavan: espolonear — they were spurring (imperfect 3rd pl.; = espoloneaban)
firidlos: ferir + los — strike them! (imperative 2nd pl. with enclitic los; = heridlos)
sines: sines — without (= sin, with added -es; sines dubdança 'without hesitation')
ganancia: ganancia — gain, booty (spelling variant of ganançia; = ganancia)
bueltos: buelto — mingled, mixed in (past part. of bolver; bueltos son con ellos 'they are mixed in with them'; = vueltos, envueltos)
llaña: llaña — flat ground, plain (= llana, llanura)
bueno: bueno — good, fine, great (qué bueno es el gozo 'how great is the joy'; = bueno)
aguijavan: aguijar — they were spurring on, hastening (imperfect 3rd pl.; = aguijaban)
essora: essora — then, at that moment (ess' + ora; en essora 'at that moment'; = entonces)
entravan: entrar — they were entering (imperfect 3rd pl.; = entraban)
piedad: piedad — pity, mercy; sin piedad 'without mercy'
dexando: dexar — leaving, letting go by (gerund; dexando van los delant 'they go on leaving them (to pass) ahead'; = dejando)
delant: delant — ahead, in front (apocopated adverb; = delante)
poral: pora + el — toward the (pora 'toward, for' + article; Pidal restores the a: por[a]l castiello 'toward the castle'; = para el, hacia el)
tornavan: tornar — they turned back, returned (imperfect 3rd pl.; = tornaban)
desnudas: desnudo — bare, drawn (fem. pl., of swords; = desnudas)
paravan: parar(se) — they took their stand, halted (imperfect 3rd pl., reflexive; = paraban)
llegavan: llegar — they were arriving, came up (imperfect 3rd pl.; = llegaban)
per: Per — Pero, short for Pedro (Per Vermudoz = Pedro Bermúdez, a vassal of the Cid)
metióla: meter + la — he put it (preterite 3rd sg. with enclitic la; metióla en somo 'planted it on top'; = la metió)
fue: seer — he was (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora fue nado 'was born in a good hour'; = fue)
mejoraremos: mejorar — we shall improve (future 1st pl.; mejoraremos posadas 'we shall better our lodgings'; = mejoraremos)
dueños: dueño — master, owner, lord (pl.; a dueños e a cavallos 'for masters and horses'; = dueños)
cauallos: cavallo — horse (pl., spelling with u; = caballos)
preso: prender — taken (past part.; grand aver avemos preso 'we have taken great wealth'; = preso, prendido)
podremos: poder — we shall be able (future 1st pl.; = podremos)
descabeçemos: descabeçar — (that) we behead (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que los descabeçemos 'if we behead them'; = descabecemos)
ganaremos: ganar — we shall gain (future 1st pl.; = ganaremos)
cojámoslos: coger + los — let us take, gather them (present subjunctive 1st pl. with enclitic los; cojámoslos de dentro 'let us take them from inside', exact sense uncertain; = cojámoslos)
tenemos: tener — we have, hold (present 1st pl.; = tenemos)
posaremos: posar — we shall lodge, stay (future 1st pl.; = posaremos)
serviremos: servir — we shall make use of, be served by (future 1st pl., nos serviremos reflexive; = serviremos)

__broaden__.bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you') · bien — very, quite, intensifying an adverb (bien çerca del agua 'very near the water')
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking')
__broaden__.poblado: poblado — inhabited place, settlement (noun from poblar; = poblado) · also poblar — settled, encamped (past part.; avie poblado 'had settled, camped')
__broaden__.mas: mas — but · also mas — 'most' (superlative, = más; en todo lo mas alto 'on the very highest part')
__broaden__.dava: dar — he gave (imperfect) · also dar se — 'to give itself up, surrender' (Alcoçer non se le dava 'Alcocer did not surrender to him')
__broaden__.le: le — to him, him (dative pronoun) · also le — him, as direct object (leísmo; si ellos le prenden 'if they take him'); dative (non se le dava 'did not surrender to him')
__broaden__.cojó: coger — he gathered, took (preterite 3rd sg., spelt with j; = cogió); with se, 'to join': con ellos' cojó = con ellos se cogió, 'he joined them' · also cojó' = cojós, coger + se — he went off, set off (cojó' Salón ayuso 'he set off down the Jalón'; elided se)
__broaden__.dios: Dios — God · also Dios! — interjection of wonder (Dios, cómmo se alabavan! 'God, how they boasted!')
__broaden__.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing')
__broaden__.antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him')
__broaden__.priessa: priessa — haste, bustle (a una priessa 'all in one bustle'; = prisa) · also a priessa — 'quickly, in haste' (adverbial; a priessa espoloneavan 'they spurred in haste')
__broaden__.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least' · also a + el standing for a + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (al espada = a la espada) · also al — 'other thing, the rest' (neuter, Latin alius; de lo al non pienssan nada 'of anything else they think nothing'; distinct from a + el)
__broaden__.davan: dar — they were giving (imperfect 3rd pl.; salto davan 'they made a dash'; = daban) · also dar — 'to deal blows' (sin piedad les davan 'they struck them without mercy')
__broaden__.merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced) · also merçed — grace, favour (con la merçed del Criador 'by the grace of the Creator')
__broaden__.avemos: aver — we have (present 1st pl.; = hemos) · avemos de + inf. 'we must' (mucho avemos de andar 'we have far to go'); avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of' · also perfect auxiliary aver + participle (avemos preso 'we have taken')
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain')
__broaden__.dan: dar — they give (present 3rd pl.; vagar non se dan 'they allow themselves no leisure'; = dan) · also dar — 'to pay (tribute)' (dan parias 'they pay tribute')
__broaden__.tornar: tornar — to return; tornar palabra 'to answer a word' · also tornar — 'to give back' (tornar nos la ha doblada 'will give it back to us doubled'; infinitive + enclitic + ha, future); to turn (round), transitive (mandó tornar la seña 'he had the banner turned about')
__broaden__.en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak') · also en — 'as' (en paria 'as tribute'); en essora 'at that moment'
__broaden__.fita: Fita — Hita, town in Guadalajara province (f- for h-; = Hita; traditional identification) · also fito — fixed, pitched (past part. fem., Latin fictus; una tienda fita 'one tent left pitched'; = hincada)
__broaden__.ganar: ganar — to gain, earn · also 'to capture, take (a fortress)' (Alcoçer cueda ganar 'he expects to take Alcocer') · also ganar — to till, work the land (Pidal, like Old French gaignier; non se treven ganar 'they dare not work their fields'; = labrar)
__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará)
__broaden__.avié: aver — he had (imperfect of aver = haber, here a full verb 'to have, hold') · also impersonal 'there was' (mucho avié grant plaça 'there was a very great space'; = había)
